---
name: requirements-analysis
description: Analyze a Story to extract observable business behavior, acceptance criteria, ambiguity, dependencies and open questions. Use before implementation or QA design.
argument-hint: "[Story]"
---

# Requirements Analysis

1. Identify business goal.
2. Extract acceptance criteria.
3. Map business rules.
4. Identify dependencies and out-of-scope behavior.
5. Find contradictions.
6. Mark missing information `OPEN`.
7. Produce a concise behavior model.

Do not invent requirements or turn implementation details into business rules.
